info.title: KEV API
info.description: Educational system with Central Library and Curriculum Framework for 185+ subjects

get.description: Study levels: the same subjects adapt to every grade via these contracts.

World language catalog: 198 countries with official + major local
languages, the full language registry, and the UI-bundle subset.

country: ISO-3166 code (e.g. ZA) -> that country + its languages.
q: search across country names and language names/native names.

Every floor of the school.

``scope=all`` (default) returns the full consolidated campus: floor 0 the
Grand Concourse Hallway, the four original XR wings (floors 1-4, with class
annexes appended where a subject wing lives there), and the six new subject
floors 5-10 that house all 176 classes.

``scope=legacy`` returns only floors 1-4 exactly as they were before
consolidation, for any client still assuming a four-floor tower.

``FLOORS`` (the module-level name) still refers to the original four-floor
payload and is untouched.

The whole school in one payload: hallway, all floors, all 14 subject wings
with their 176 classes and 872 tutor agents, the virtual-school building
(6 levels / 14 bookable facilities), and corridor geometry the 3D renderer
needs to lay rooms out along the hallway spine.
Floor 0 — the Grand Concourse Hallway that every other floor hangs off.

All 14 subject wings — every specialization, education level and the real
``tutor_id``s of the five role-agents behind each class. Filter with
``?subject=Mathematics`` (registry name or slug).
One class: its subject, level, floor, room and the tutors assigned to it.

The KEV International Virtual School as campus data — six building levels
(basement to roof) and its fourteen facilities, read from the same live
``VirtualSchoolBuilding`` the booking API uses, so capacities, equipment and
virtual tools shown in XR are the real ones.

post.description: On-demand consultation with any faculty tutor (stateless).
Professor KEV Socratic tutor for the active 3D lab simulation.

get.description:
Unified learning-surface index: every immersive subject with its tutor,
XR lab, floor, curriculum track, and frontend routes â€” plus EVERY live
curriculum-engine subject (dynamic: anything added via
POST /curriculum/subjects appears here automatically), each mapped to the
closest faculty tutor so all subjects get equal Q&A quality.

level: elementary | middle | high | university | professional (or free
text like 'Grade 4'). Defaults to high.

Per-student next steps: unlocked curriculum subjects (dependency-aware)
enriched with tutor + immersive links, at the student's level.

completed: comma-separated subject ids, e.g. 'science_101,xr_chem'.

Live bookable campus facilities with suggested XR Academy counterparts,
so the two campus realities cross-link instead of competing.
Age bands, their study levels and the protections each one carries.
Lessons open right now. Carries no roster identities - see the store.
Students and observers read the board; only the owner writes it.

A student's own mark record. There is deliberately no route that
returns someone else's.

Study-pack topics and curriculum subjects a teacher can pin to a board.

Read-only over existing content (backend/library_content.py and the
curriculum engine) - teachers assemble, they do not upload, so there is no
unmoderated material path into a classroom.

The seven wearable sites and three LED wavelengths with their teaching
copy, atlas anchors (BodyParts3D part ids) and slider limits, so the UI
never hard-codes the model's envelope.

post.description:
Deterministic 8-second PPG trace + derived metrics. The server is the
authority: Twin Challenge pulse twins re-simulate from the same model when
they re-score, exactly like every other KEV simulation.

post.description:
Stateless per-request call to a KEV agent via Bedrock.

The caller (frontend) owns conversation history and passes it in each
time via `history` - nothing is stored server-side, so this works the
same on any Fargate task behind the load balancer.
Register or update a student profile.
Start a new learning session for a student.
Complete an active learning session and store the result.

Join the VR/AR school environment. Returns the new user + the scene as
this cohort sees it (never the whole building's presence).
Leave the VR/AR environment.
Move a user within the VR/AR environment (triggers proximity interactions).
Run one of the environment's validated object interaction handlers.
Start a VR class/meeting session.
End a VR class/meeting session.

get.description:
Current state of the VR/AR environment, scoped to the viewer's cohort.

`viewer` is the caller's own username; presence of other age bands is
withheld entirely, which is the point - students must not be able to
observe who else is in the building outside their cohort.
Exported VR scene for rendering (objects + this cohort's positions).
Metadata-only listing of the real multi_agents/ tutor roster - no imports happen here.

post.description:
Stateless per-request call to a REAL multi_agents/ tutor file. Lazily
imports + instantiates only this one agent (agent_catalog.py), then
routes the actual reply through Bedrock using the agent's real
subject/specialization metadata - safe to run on any Fargate task.
